feasibility_of_merging.covariate_shift: All overlapping numerical (p < 0.001) and categorical (p < 0.001) distributions differ systematically.
feasibility_of_merging.label_shift: Target constructs are fundamentally distinct: self-reported survey indicator (A) vs self-reported professional diagnosis (B).
feasibility_of_merging.contamination_risk: Combining 162 (or 113) real local responses with 27,901 synthetic/crowdsourced records would swamp the local signal (0.4% weight) while poisoning evaluation.
